scorable.instructions: Is there enough visible image content to assess technical quality and composition? A blank or wholly obscured image is not scorable. A diagram or render can be scorable.

technical_quality.instructions: Rate visible technical fidelity, independently of beauty, subject, medium and suspected AI origin. Consider blur, noise, exposure, clipping, blocking and visible detail. Intentional background blur is not a defect by itself.
criteria: 1 bad: severe defects obscure almost all useful detail
2 poor: major defects impair the main content
3 fair: visible defects, main content remains usable
4 good: minor defects, clear main content
5 excellent: clean detail and well-controlled exposure, no visible material defect

aesthetics.instructions: Rate visual appeal from composition, balance, light, color, coherence and expressive effect. Do not use technical sharpness, attractive subject matter, photo realism or suspected AI origin as a substitute. Judge any visual medium on its own terms.
criteria: 1 bad: incoherent or strongly distracting presentation
2 poor: weak organization and distracting visual choices
4 good: intentional, balanced and engaging presentation
5 excellent: exceptional visual coherence and expressive impact

severe_defect.instructions: Does obvious technical damage or lack of visible content make this image unusable as a visual reference at the supplied scale? Major blur, noise, compression or exposure failure count. Low aesthetics, illustration, rendering or suspected AI origin alone do not count.

origin.instructions: Which origin or medium does the visible evidence support? This is visual suspicion, not provenance verification. Do not equate CGI, diagrams or stylization with generative AI. Prefer unknown when cues are weak or competing.

criteria.camera_photo: Looks like a camera photo of a real scene; origin remains unverified
criteria.ai_suspected: Specific visible synthesis anomalies suggest generative AI
criteria.diagram: Chart, diagram, interface, graphic or illustration without specific AI evidence
criteria.unknown: Image alone does not distinguish the possible origins

sexual_content.instructions: Classify visible sexual content for a general-audience photo pool. Do not infer age or sexual intent from identity, body shape or skin tone. Swimwear and ordinary portraits alone are not explicit. Use unknown if detail is insufficient. This does not assess violence or other safety categories.

criteria.clear: No visible nudity, sexual activity or sexualized presentation
criteria.suggestive: Sexualized presentation without visible explicit activity or intimate nudity
criteria.nonsexual_nudity: Visible intimate nudity in nonsexual, artistic or medical context
criteria.explicit: Visible sexual activity or explicit sexual display
criteria.unknown: Cannot assess the category from the visible evidence
